restatement_groups.reason: All three require vehicles with a lower bumper height below 425 mm to be tested with the lower legform.
Both require the upper legform test when the lower bumper height is more than 500 mm. R-0021 is left out because its condition is 'greater than or equal to' 500 mm.

Both state that for a lower bumper height between 425 and 500 mm, the manufacturer chooses either the lower or the upper legform test. R-0020 is left out because its boundaries are worded differently (≥425 and <500).
Both require the bumper legform impact to be performed at 40 km/h.
